summary: Inspect and merge your uploaded PDFs and images with account-owned native storage and signed download links.

tools.name: tool_pdf_inspect
tools.purpose: Read-only inspection of owned file IDs, with page counts, fresh links and per-ID failures.
tools.connection: Local PDF engine and file store

tools.name: tool_pdf_listFiles
tools.purpose: Read-only listing of your unexpired uploads and merged files with fresh download links.

tools.name: tool_pdf_merge
tools.purpose: Merge an ordered structured plan into a new PDF (MCP-only).
tools.connection: Local PDF engine and file store

params.name: file_ids
params.description: Comma-separated IDs from your chat uploads or file list; at most 100.

workflow.explanation: Upload PDFs or supported images through Ember chat.
Find usable file IDs owned by the signed-in account.
Check page counts and IDs before selecting pages.
Submit ordered page segments and output options, then save the returned download link.
Renew an expired download link while the stored file still exists.
